specAmbiguitiesResolved: The compatibility/safety policy (FR-21 portion) is an optional `compatibility` section of the AUTHORITY policy revision, so one immutable revision governs decisions, approvals and the action digest; the policy-named approver role comes from that revision's approvalLimits (PLAN_ACTION, POLICY_OVERRIDE or STANDARD class, currency, amount, site), restricted to approver-capable roles.

Authority records are evidence for the tuple: the decision tuple is (candidate -> asset/evidence/policy revisions + action digest) plus an authority-set digest over each record's signature, lifecycle, expiry and exact role grants, so recording, expiry, revocation or role change always yields a new tuple and a new row; M05 evidence revisions are not re-committed for an approval.

Authoritative sources are declared by policy per fact category (role x source kind x trust); M05 OPERATOR_ATTESTED OEM uploads can be authoritative, PROVIDER_DOCUMENT/COMMUNICATION, PROVIDER_REPORTED and semantic/model bases never can. Warranty and vendor status come from the revision's REGISTRY_SNAPSHOT documents.

Engineer exceptions cover part identity (SUBSTITUTE/NON_EXACT_MATCH) and unverified candidate-side constraints, and SAFETY_CRITICAL/COMPONENT_UNCLASSIFIED; known incompatibility, conflicts, missing evidence, certification and stale offers are never coverable. Only VENDOR_* and WARRANTY_* reasons are policy-overridable.
Evaluation is engine-only (service/worker); humans register candidates and record authority. A stale candidate tuple is refused (CANDIDATE_TUPLE_STALE) rather than persisted.
Evidence and policy changes also invalidate unexecuted M02 approvals (single INVALIDATED event, untouched if an event such as M09's CONSUMED exists); the SEND_STARTED race is M09/T-040.

Safety class: asset floor (STANDARD or SAFETY_CRITICAL) raised by matching rules; a component is classified only by a rule naming it; component keys must already be canonical (refused otherwise at evaluation and publication).
unresolvedRisks: HMAC key management: single env-provided key per workload (retired keys must be kept in the keyring for verification/reproduction); no KMS, rotation tooling or asymmetric signatures.
No separation-of-duties rule: the engineer who registers a candidate may approve its exception.
activateEffectivePolicy must be scheduled (worker sweep) for future-dated revisions; until then the execution gate already refuses stale decisions.
Certification and candidate spec claims rely on exact cited text containment, not structured extraction; M05 extracts only a few spec keys, so mechanical constraints are limited to those keys.
Approval invalidation on policy change covers all unexecuted approvals of the tenant, including BUDGET_ADJUSTMENT.

Engine (service with compatibility.engine): evaluateCandidate(pool, ctx, {candidateActionId}, signing) -> DecisionView {decision, lifecycle, reasonCodes, blockingReasons, missingFields, conflictingFields, requiredAuthorities, recoveryPaths, approvalRoute {outcome AUTO_PERMITTED|REQUIRES_APPROVAL|HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE|REJECT, requirements}, safetyClass, inputDigest, authoritySetDigest, created}; getDecision, listDecisions, reproduceDecision(…, signing).

Execution gate (M08 plan, M09 broker): assertDecisionExecutableInTx(client, ctx, {compatibilityDecisionId, actionDigest}, signing) inside the linearization transaction (FOR SHARE on the decision) or checkDecisionExecutable(pool, …); throws POLICY_HOLD (DECISION_NOT_CURRENT, POLICY_REVISION_NOT_EFFECTIVE, EVIDENCE_REVISION_NOT_CURRENT, ASSET_REVISION_SUPERSEDED, DECISION_NOT_ALLOW, STALE_PRICE_OR_STOCK, AUTHORITY_*) or DIGEST_MISMATCH. approvalRoute.requirements AMOUNT_OUT_OF_BOUNDS names the roles M09's recordApproval must use.

Authority (UI M13 via human ctx): recordAuthority(pool, ctx, {compatibilityDecisionId, kind ENGINEER_EXCEPTION|POLICY_APPROVAL, reasonCode, reasonText, expiresAt}, signing); getAuthorityRecord; revokeAuthority(pool, ctx, id, reasonCode). signing = authoritySigningFromEnv() in the authority workload only.

Policy (admin): publishCompatibilityPolicy(pool, ctx, {body: {approvalLimits, compatibility}, effectiveAt?, source}), validatePolicyDraft(body), listPolicyHistory; worker sweep activateEffectivePolicy(pool, ctx).
